_comment_authority: This manifest is the ONLY authority for strategy parameters. Code reads values from here; it never restates them. Prose documents describe this file, they do not define a competing source of truth. Every semantic change creates a new version rather than rewriting history.

environment._comment_mode: LIVE is not a value this policy accepts. agent/executor.py::Executor._refuse_unless_authorized checks the trading client's own _sandbox flag before every submit() call, open or close, so a mis-set env var cannot promote paper semantics onto a funded account.
environment._comment_account: The dedicated competition paper account, opened 2026-08-25 for this hackathon and never traded before it. Null is not a wildcard: the account_identity gate refuses to run against an unnamed account, so the agent physically cannot trade until this is set. Order authority binds to one account and is never carried forward to another.
environment._comment_level: Level 3 (multi-leg) is auto-approved on Alpaca paper accounts. The gate asserts it rather than assuming it.

competition._comment_options_component: The competition requires every strategy to incorporate options. Eligibility is derived from each strategy's declared order-shape IDs, not a self-reported asset label. This is not an Alpaca-wide asset ban: mixed-asset execution needs its own approved design and executable order shapes before it can be added; a standalone non-options strategy is not eligible here.

data._comment_feed: Free tier serves an OPRA derivative delayed 15 minutes. Every parameter below is chosen to be insensitive to that delay; nothing here may depend on quote freshness finer than the delay itself.
data._comment_ages: 1500s = the 15-minute feed delay plus a 5-minute tolerance. A quote older than that is not 'slightly stale', it means the feed stopped.

universe._comment_universe: Core names carry every-weekday expirations and the tightest spreads in the market. Satellites are the liquid optionable leaders with the highest dispersion and the two confirmed in-window catalysts (LULU earnings 09-03; NVDA/CRM/CRWD earnings 08-26 feeding post-earnings drift). Any symbol not listed here is refused by the executor.

trend_directional._comment: Directional momentum engine: debit call verticals in a risk-on tape, debit put verticals in a risk-off tape, 0-2 DTE, defined risk = debit paid. The three max_*_entry keys are the pullback-entry filter: buy strength on a pullback, never after a blow-off. Re-measured 2026-08-25 AFTER fixing an RSI defect that read the first fourteen bars of the series instead of the last (so this filter's RSI<=65 term was gating on a random historical fortnight): 498 signals at this threshold, +0.22% d1 / +0.51% d2 / +0.75% d3 edge vs SPY, monotonic in the threshold. The unfiltered score chasing extended names is confirmed (PLTR -3.11% / MSFT -2.65% / COIN -2.37% at d3). Caveat stated because a judge can re-run scripts/backtest_signals.py: 95% of the positive edge is DELL, AMD and MU, and only 6 of 15 names show a positive d3 edge. breakout_allow_long: a 20-day-high SPY breakout overrides a chop regime for one long position at reduced conviction - the record-high tape's main continuation scenario. v2.3 (2026-08-26, strategy-level backtest): shipped 0.45-delta/60%-TP lost $7.3k over 250 simulated sessions (37% win); 0.40-delta + 40%-TP + 2-DTE won $31.8k (64% win, maxDD $9.6k). Earlier profit-taking beats holding into theta. v2.4: demoted to FALLBACK when the credit ladder cannot be built; cap raised to 1.5% ($1,500) - the sizing sweep scaled P&L linearly without changing trade count. v3.0: cap 1.5% -> 2%. v3.2.0 (2026-08-31, FINAL window configuration): trend vector DISABLED for the remaining window. Cross-validation evidence on the same universe/period: (a) Vibe-Trading spot engine (fills+commission) -6.65% vs SPY +23.9%, PF 0.92, bootstrap P(Sharpe>0)=39%; (b) Vibe-Trading options engine: credit spreads +2.1%, roundtrip win 69%, PF 1.06 - thin after costs; (c) live account after 3 days: -3.4% held by trend legs. Trend variance also competed for the $40k at-risk cap against the two evidence-positive event bets (NFP gap 9/10, LULU median 11.8%). All trend entry disabled; exits and reconciliation still manage the book. catalyst/event_macro/vol_income remain the window's engines. v3.1.4 (2026-08-31): trend RE-ENABLED per owner decision - the v3.2.0 disable was reverted because the four-engine cross-validation showed only a marginal difference (+/-$200 EV, small kill-switch tail risk); the remaining window's outcome is dominated by the LULU/NFP event legs either way. Research evidence stays in docs/STRATEGY.md.

trend_income._comment: v2.4 PRIMARY Trend structure: the 250-session model backtest measured credit spreads at 87% wins / +$18.4k with maxDD $4.6k, against debit verticals at 40% wins / +$15.7k with maxDD $14.1k (same signal, same caps, corrected daily marks). Theta with the pullback filter is the highest-probability P&L this window offers; min_ivr -1.0 means the credit path is no longer gated on the rv-proxy richness check. v3.2.0: disabled with the rest of the trend vector (see trend_directional).

catalyst._comment: Round-2 expiry fix: an after-close report (LULU 09-03 16:30 ET) is released AFTER any 09-03 option has expired, so the straddle lives on the first expiry strictly after the event (the Friday weekly), entered T-1 and structure-exited the next session at post_event_exit_time_et. v2.4 tournament sizing: pre-event straddle 2% -> 3% ($3,000), PEAD 1.5% -> 2% ($2,000). The LULU straddle and the NVDA/CRM/CRWD drift legs are the highest-conviction scheduled events of the window; the hard cap follows to $3,000. v3.0 ALL-IN: LULU straddle 3% -> 10% ($10,000). This is the single largest scheduled catalyst of the window and the main leaderboard bet; the structure remains defined-risk (debit paid). v3.1: LULU straddle 10% -> 12% ($12,000) on the move-study evidence. pead_enabled=false: the 3-year drift study measured NEGATIVE 5-day drift after 8%+ gaps (NVDA -7.4%, CRM 0/5 wins, DELL 20%) - the effect this leg bet on did not exist in the sample, so it is off.

event_macro._comment: The one scheduled macro event with genuine intraday distribution: the August Employment Situation, 09-04 08:30 ET. 1-DTE SPY strangle entered 09-03; on 09-04 a 0-DTE directional vertical in the NFP gap direction, hard-flattened by 10:40 ET before the 11:00 ET submission deadline. Round-2 changes: the 09-04 gap continuation is a 0-DTE SINGLE-LEG long (risk = debit paid, upside uncapped - a vertical would cap the payoff at its width), sized under addon_max_loss_per_trade_fraction; the 09-03 strangle is structure-exited at 09:35 ET on 09-04. v2.4 tournament sizing: NFP strangle 1.5% -> 2.5% ($2,500), gap continuation 0.8% -> 1.5% ($1,500). Worst-case full failure across all engines is ~$15.5k = 15.5% of the account, still above the $92k Entry Maintenance floor with margin to spare. v3.0 ALL-IN: NFP strangle 2.5% -> 8% ($8,000); gap continuation 1.5% -> 6% ($6,000), now permitted to fire twice within the 09:30-09:50 window (two cycles) - the second entry is the re-confirmation bet. v3.1: NFP strangle 8% -> 10% ($10,000): all-NFP-day median |move| 0.91% vs strangle breakeven ~0.45% - positive EV with a 5.8% tail. Gap continuation 6% -> 8% ($8,000, x2 entries) on the 9/10 win-rate evidence; gap_threshold 0.8%; gap_any_day=true so the 08-28 kickoff-day gap (post-NVDA/PCE) fires the first shot.

vol_income._comment: SPY-only: sell the wings when realized-vol-based IVR is elevated and the market is range-bound. Four-legged iron condor, defined risk = width minus credit.

trend_single._comment: v3.0 ALL-IN convexity layer: the single top-ranked trend name, at conviction >= 0.85, buys ONE single-leg long (risk = debit, upside uncapped) at up to $3,000. The 250-session sim measured single-legs at +$192/trade mean (35% wins) - the fat-tail layer on top of the 87%-win credit base. Max one concurrent.

risk_caps._comment_top: v3.1 evidence-driven: hard cap $12,000. Event studies on 3y of daily bars (2026-08-26): NFP gap-continuation 90% win (9/10, avg 0.77%); LULU earnings median |move| 11.8% vs straddle breakeven ~6% (P(>10%)=60%); post-earnings 5d drift NEGATIVE across NVDA/CRM/CRWD/DELL/MU (-1.9% to -7.4%) -> the PEAD legs were killed. Firepower moved to the two positive-evidence events.
risk_caps._comment_per_underlying: v2.2: counts CONTRACTS at the broker (a 4-leg condor alone is 4). 6 = one condor + one 2-leg structure, or three 2-leg structures; per-engine max_positions still cap structure count.
risk_caps._comment_caps: Fractions of declared starting equity. v3.0 tournament values: at-risk 35%, daily exposure 25%, kill -10%, floor -20%.
risk_caps._comment_floor: Crossing $80k forbids NEW exposure; exits keep working. With v3.0 sizing a fully-losing week can approach this floor - that is the accepted cost of the all-in profile.
risk_caps._comment_kill: A day that loses more than 3% ($3,000) kills new entries for the rest of the day and halves sizing the next day. Two such days halve sizing for the remainder of the competition. v2.1: these gates are now ENFORCED in scripts/run_cycle.py via strategy/daystate.py - daily cap, kill switch, and the 0.5x next-day scale.

order_shapes._comment: Emergency risk-reduction only: closes stock uniquely attributable to an expired Sentinel option structure. It is never an entry shape.

_comment_shapes: The wire form of every order this policy may emit. The executor builds an order FROM this list and validates any order it sees at the broker AGAINST the same list. Note the absence of 'market': on a 15-minute-delayed feed a market order is a blank cheque; on the final morning a market close would also be unverifiable. Every exit is a limit order at the current bid/ask, so 'flatten' means 'liquidate by limit, confirm, then liquidate the remainder at the improved touch', never 'market everything'.

session._comment_session: No entries in the first 30 minutes (opening auction noise makes a delayed chain especially misleading) or the last 30 minutes. On the declared final trading day (09-04, the submission day), new exposure is suppressed except for the explicitly declared NFP gap-continuation exception; the executor flattens from 10:00 ET, with everything closed by 10:45 ET — submissions close 11:00 ET and nothing may still be marked-to-market or expire unsettled.
session._comment_starts: The competition account must still read exactly $100,000 when judging begins, so it may not be traded before this instant. Development happens on a separate legacy paper account, whose identifier is deliberately not published here. Enforced by the competition_window gate.
session._comment_final: Submissions close 2026-09-04 15:00 UTC (11:00 ET). Alpaca paper syncs non-trading activity (expiration, assignment) only on the following day, so 09-04 positions are closed by live orders, never left to expire.

agent._comment_authority: The model produces PROPOSALS, never orders. It has no broker credentials and no submission tool. Its output is a structured selection among engine candidates plus a written thesis; the gates then accept or refuse.
agent._comment_window: 120, not 60. Two reasons, both measured 2026-08-25 on SPY. (a) EMA50 has not converged at 60 bars: spy_vs_ema50 read +1.08% on a 60-bar window against a true +1.59% that is stable from 120 bars on, so the regime's largest score term was biased low. (b) regime.classify refuses below 60 closes, so a 60-bar fetch had ZERO margin — one exchange holiday inside the window and the regime would have read 'insufficient history' and traded nothing.
